past.title: Healing the Woman Within
past.subtitle: Transforming past pain into personal power
past.descriptionShort: Gathering 4 was a room to stop managing old pain and finally meet it, with compassion, honesty, and other women who understood the weight carried in.
past.descriptionMedium:
Every woman carries something: a season that broke her open, a wound she has been managing instead of meeting. Healing the Woman Within was a room to finally meet herself, with honesty and compassion.

Gathering 4 was a curated, intimate space to stop managing pain and start meeting it, leaving lighter, clearer, and more whole than when they arrived.
past.descriptionFull:
Every woman carries something: a season that broke her open, a version of herself she left behind, a wound she has been managing instead of meeting.

Healing the Woman Within was the fourth Elysian House gathering: a curated, intimate space for women ready to stop managing their pain and start meeting it with compassion. Through guided reflection, honest conversation, and the emotionally safe room Elysian House is built to provide, every woman left lighter, clearer, and more whole.

This was not therapy. This was not a workshop. This was a room, and in that room, the woman within finally got to breathe.
past.experienceBlock: Women sat in circle and around the table, meeting the questions that matter most, naming the wisdom they carry and the beliefs they are ready to rewrite. They left lighter, more connected, and reminded that the woman beside them understands.
exploreBullets: Meeting your pain with compassion, without reliving it
The stories you built to survive, and the ones ready to be rewritten
Alchemizing pain into strength, depth, and wisdom
Coming home to the woman within, gently and without judgment
past.closingNote: The wound is not where she is broken. It is where the light is finally getting in.

past.title: The Courage to Choose Yourself
past.subtitle: Boundaries, self-trust, and living a life that is true to you
past.descriptionShort: Gathering 3 gave women the space to honour boundaries, deepen self-trust, and choose a life aligned with what is true—building on Becoming Her.
past.descriptionMedium:
Becoming Her asked who you are underneath the roles. The Courage to Choose Yourself asked what you would do now that you know.

Gathering 3 was a curated, intimate space to pause, reflect, and have the honest conversations most of us avoid—no performances, just a room built for truth.
past.descriptionFull:
Becoming Her asked who you are underneath the roles. The Courage to Choose Yourself asked what you would do now that you know.

Gathering 3 built on Becoming Her—guided reflection, honest conversation, and the safe room Elysian House is known for.

This gathering created space for women to choose themselves—not as selfishness, but as the most responsible thing they could do for themselves and those they love.
past.experienceBlock: Across keynote, panel, and circle conversation, women named the cost of putting themselves last and left with permission—and a plan—to honour their own boundaries.
exploreBullets: Boundaries and the cost of saying yes when you meant no
Rebuilding self-trust and your own intuition
Alignment between the life you live and the life that is true to you
The real price of putting yourself last
Permission to choose yourself and honour one boundary
past.closingNote: Knowing who you are is just the beginning. The real courage is choosing her. Every single day.

past.title: Becoming Her
past.subtitle: The Woman You're Meant to Be
past.descriptionShort: After seasons of survival and healing, many women reach a moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now? This gathering is a space to pause, reflect, and reconnect with yourself.
past.descriptionMedium:
After seasons of survival and healing, many women arrive at a powerful moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now?

Becoming Her was an invitation to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman emerging within you. Through honest conversations, shared experiences, and guided reflection, we explored identity, courage, and the journey of becoming.
past.descriptionFull:
After seasons of survival and healing, many women arrive at a powerful moment of reflection: Who am I becoming now?

Becoming Her was an invitation to pause, reflect, and reconnect with the woman emerging within you. Through honest conversations, shared experiences, and guided reflection, we explored identity, courage, and the journey of becoming.

This gathering created a space for women to transform past pain into personal power and begin stepping more confidently into the next chapter of their lives.
past.experienceBlock: Women showed up with honesty about survival, healing, and identity—and left with sharper clarity on who they are becoming, strengthened self-trust, and connection with others walking the same path.

past.title: Transform and Thrive
past.subtitle: From Survival to Thriving
past.descriptionShort: The first Elysian House gathering, an intimate space for women moving from surviving toward thriving, with honesty and shared experience.
past.descriptionMedium: Transform and Thrive was the first Elysian House gathering, a curated, intimate space for women moving beyond surviving toward truly thriving. Together they built safety, honesty, and shared reflection; one room grew into a community of women choosing their lives intentionally.
past.descriptionFull:
Transform and Thrive was the first Elysian House gathering, a curated, intimate space for women ready to move beyond surviving and begin the journey of truly thriving.

Women came together in a room built on safety, honesty, and shared experience. Through guided reflection and open conversation, they began to explore what it means not only to manage their lives, but to choose them intentionally.

What started as one room became the foundation of a growing community of women finding their way home to themselves.
past.experienceBlock: Women arrived as strangers and left as a community built on honest conversations, shared stories, and presence without performance.
